defects.description: Task cards lack subtle shadows or borders to clearly separate them from the column background
Column headers (To Do, In Progress, Done) are small and could use more visual weight or a clearer separation from the card area

top_fixes: Add subtle box-shadows or 1px borders to task cards for better depth and separation
Increase font size or add bold weight to column headers for better hierarchy
Ensure consistent vertical spacing between the two cards in each column

manifest.prompt: Create a kanban board with three columns - To Do, In Progress, Done - each column containing two task cards with a short realistic title and a small colored tag.
